QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Save the Soldiers
QuestInfo.0:
#e#bDefense Mission - Captured Soldiers#k#n

#bMission Period#k
11/28/2018 - 12/12/2018 1:00 PM

The world is shrouded in the Black Mage's sinister energy. Rescue the soldiers trapped by this dark energy and prepare for the final battle. You'll acquire determination for rescuing soldiers, and each rescued soldier will help you in battle for a certain amount of time before returning to the battleground.

#bYou cannot perform this mission once you have collected 50,000 determination for the day.#k
